_comment: Zid live captures. ZID_TEST_PLAN.md's evidence rule: 'A test that passes without its capture saved is NOT passed.' One JSON object per line. `capture` is the C-id where the plan defines one; entries without a C-id are state captures that still evidence a case. RAW envelopes (headers + bodies) are what C1-C11 actually ask for — the entries below are DERIVED state, which is weaker, and each says so in `evidence_kind`. Do not delete a line to 'tidy up': a capture removed is a case reopened.

what: App-Market install of app 7367 on dev store 3195980 created the store row
note: Both credentials encrypted (dual-credential design, migration 0146). Token life ~3 years, which is why F-1 can never fire naturally before 2029. RAW C1/C2 token+profile envelopes still owed.

what: Webhook registration result, all six events
resolves: ZID_APP_ID is 7367 (not the Client ID 7192) - prod runs ZID_APP_ID=7367 and zid.ts:227 sends it as original_id. Scope of proof: the WEBHOOK half only; the same value is also read as app_id on the billing subscription (section H), which is unproven.
note: Per-event HTTP status codes not captured - the A-2 duplicate-status question (409 vs 422) is still open.

what: Logged-out App-Market install auto-provisioned a merchant account, no login page
note: The logged-out precondition is proven by code, not recollection: provisionMerchant is reachable ONLY from the else branch of `if (userId)` (ecommerceControllers.ts:219, :263), so an auto-provisioned user cannot exist if a session was present. C12 (raw redirect chain) still owed.

Subscription row created 13 ms after the user - same provisioning path. It now reads manual/active to 2026-09-22 because the owner set it afterwards; zid_store_id empty, consistent with section H never having run.

what: First successful Zid product sync ever, for any store
note: Root cause of the prior 401 was a missing `Store-Id: <merchantId>` header (#865); `Role: Manager` was removed in the same change and proven a no-op. Hidden fifth product correctly absent (F2). Sale price honoured: نظارة شمسية at 250 SAR, not the 400 SAR list price (F4). Same sync reproduced F1 (unlimited item stored as total_inventory 0), fixed same day. RAW products envelope still owed - so is the >100-product pagination case.

data.trigger: dashboard image uploads (each saves instantly and fires product.update)
data.result: Basic-auth verified -> sync enqueued -> all 4 rows carried media.zid.store image URLs

note: Auth negatives ran the same day: wrong Basic -> 401, no auth header -> 401, no writes in either case. Raw headers/body not saved - that gap is why the order-webhook captures C5-C8 must be saved verbatim.

what: FB page linked to the Zid store
Real Messenger DMs to the linked page answered from the Zid catalog

data.sony_ar_en: متوفرة (F1 answered correctly in a real DM)

note: First DM got NO reply: the auto-provisioned workspace is seeded messagesAutoReply:false on purpose (D-025). Every auto-provisioned marketplace account inherits this - check it first when a new store's page is silent.

what: Product sync no longer flushes the fleet reply cache and no longer re-embeds unchanged text
note: Non-vacuous: a complete new chunk version was written while the embedding provider was never called, which only reuse produces. embedding_rag moved 50412 -> 50420 on ordinary traffic as the live-counter control.

data.?search=: USELESS - search=نظارة and search=كاميرا each returned ALL 4 products (count 4); it ignores the term
data.?in_stock=true: works - returned only the one sellable product
data.unknown id: HTTP 400, NOT an empty list - a by-id reader must treat 400 as 'no such product', not as an API failure

note: This kills the planned 'swap in Zid server-side search' option. Product resolution has to be solved on our side - D-092.

what: FIRST live Zid order webhook round-trip. Order 72524870 on dev store 3195980 flipped new -> indelivery in the Zid admin; order.status.update reached prod, passed Basic-auth, parsed, and wrote a customer_notifications_log row.

data.messageSent: Zid Customer، طلبك #mdXMlMYYBt تم شحنه 🚚 رقم التتبع:
data.errorMessage: Vonage delivery error: Quota Exceeded - rejected

resolves: C6 status spelling: Zid's canonical code is `indelivery` (lowercase, one word) — the admin's own select options are new/preparing/ready/indelivery/delivered/cancelled. The `inDelivery` camelCase variant in the webhook-conditions doc was NOT what arrived; the tolerant lowercase compare in buildZidOrderEvent covers both.
C6 tracking field: this store ships via «مندوب المتجر» (shipping_method_code `custom`) and carried NO tracking number in either location.

C5-partial envelope: the order object in the delivery carries at least `id`, `code`, `customer.name`, `customer.mobile` (966-prefixed, no `+`) and `order_status.code`. normalizeZidPhone mapped 966500000009 -> +966500000009 correctly.
Basic-auth verification passed on a real Zid delivery (the fail-closed scheme-casing guard did not reject).
defects_found: orderNumber quoted the `code` URL slug (mdXMlMYYBt) instead of the order number 72524870 — fixed on branch fix/zid-order-number-from-id.

order_shipped template renders a dangling «رقم التتبع: » label when no tracking number exists (tracking_number renders as ''). NOT fixed — shared across Salla/Shopify/Zid and touches already-seeded merchant-editable rows; owner decision.
SMS delivery failed with Vonage `Quota Exceeded - rejected` — live confirmation of the unverified-account spending limit from Vonage ticket #3002710.
note: This is the first time a Zid order webhook has round-tripped to a log row. It closes the 'do we ingest their data correctly' half of Zid rejection bullet 2 for order events, independently of SMS delivery. E-1 (order.create) still needs a real storefront order.

what: Scalar field inventory of a real Zid order — settles which field is the customer-facing order number and whether payment_status exists.
resolves: C8 payment field: `payment_status` DOES exist on Zid orders (value 'pending' here). The 'unknown' mapping can be narrowed.

Order number: `id` === `invoice_number` === 72524870 is what the Zid admin order list, the order-detail heading, and the CUSTOMER's own invoice page (https://h47p59.zid.store/o/mdXMlMYYBt/inv renders «الطلبات #72524870») all display. `code` appears only inside the invoice URL and is never shown to the customer.
note: The customer invoice page was fetched and grepped: it contains '72524870' and does NOT contain 'mdXMlMYYBt' anywhere in its rendered text.
